# AionUi Cowork Console

AionUi Cowork Console is a SaaS workspace for AionUi.

Website: https://aionuicowork.space/
Docs pattern reference: https://github.com/clauxel/MiroFish
Primary keyword: AionUi
Type: SaaS
Default plan: team

Public boundary: docs-only repository; no production source code or secrets.
